evidence.section: In vitro cytokine stimulation and functional assays of NK cells
evidence.quote: NK cells (CD45 + CD56 + CD3 − ) sorted from freshly processed tissue sites (see above) were cultured in 96-well u-bottom plates in RPMI-1640 medium containing fetal bovine serum (10%) with or without 10ng/ml IL-12 (PeproTech, cat# 200–12), 100ng/ml IL-15 (PeproTech, cat# 200–15) and 100ng/ml IL-18 (MBL International Corp.

additional_evidence.name_in_paper: For measuring degranulation by NK cells
additional_evidence.readouts: CD107a expression as a measure of degranulation after co-culture with K562 cells

evidence.section: In vitro cytokine stimulation and functional assays of NK cells
evidence.quote: For measuring degranulation by NK cells, 30,000–50,000 sorted, overnight rested NK cells were incubated with K562 cells (ATCC: CCL-243; provided by Emily Mace, Columbia University) at a 2:1 effector to target (NK: K562) ratio in a 96-well tissue culture plate at 37°C at 5% CO 2 for 4 hours.
